item.title: Reverse Engineering Raiders of the Lost Ark for the Atari 2600
item.description:
📝 bat: Windows batch script to launch the compiled game. Bank 0 (BANK0TOP = $D000): Contains game logic — collision handling, inventory management, room event handlers, scoring, movement, input processing, and sound. Phase 2: VBLANK (~37 Scanlines of CPU Time) All game logic runs while the TIA outputs a blank screen.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/joshuanwalker/Raiders2600
